hook.name: FusingFeeHook
hook.description: A shared fee hook for all fusi.ng V2 launch pools that dynamically overrides LP fees per swap using configurable per-pool terms: a resting fee plus a linear time-decaying schedule premium and a fixed anti-sniper block premium. Market makers pay zero fee; whitelisted traders via the fusi.ng router are exempt from premiums. Pool initialization is gated to pools whose terms were pre-registered by the factory.
